moments.text: Infrared view of grey sky, light at left, dark at right, with crosshair and bracket bars. A faint dark dot sits right of centre.
As the sensor pans, the dark dot wanders: to the upper right, back past the crosshair, below it, then up and left of centre.
A small box replaces the crosshair. The dot skirts around it, a large box closes over the dot, then shrinks back to a small box.
A tiny two-bar reticle holds the dot at centre while it slowly grows into a dark blob with a small bump at its upper right.
The reticle splits and the dark shape, smeared, shoots to the upper right and leaves the right edge in about 0.4 s.
The picture darkens and the two bars spread wide over empty grey sky until the end.

notes: Clip is 22.5 s, summary says 27 s.
